description: Implement .well-known/jmap and/or DNS SRV-based peer discovery as an alternative to Tailscale MagicDNS probing. This enables kith to federate with non-Tailscale JMAP Chat servers. Requires the abstract transport layer (transport trait). Identity format: the spec supports email-shaped IDs and DID URIs (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00). Transport auth: mutual TLS with WebPKI or DANE.
title: DNS-based peer discovery for JMAP Chat federation
